description: Las Lapas Lookout is one of Trinidad's most breathtaking hidden gems, perched high along the scenic Arima-Blanchissesue Road, in the heart of the Northern Range. From this stunning vantage point, sweeping panoramic views stretch across lush green hills, deep forest valleys, and all the way out to the Caribbean Sea. Listed opening hours: 24 HOURS. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
